overclaims: By October 2026 no generative-AI system had been independently verified or broadly accepted as AGI.
The Microsoft–OpenAI expert-panel process exists, but no ruling was found.
Since AGI has not arrived, the claim is not contradicted.
Shows that a formal verification route for AGI exists.
checks.note: The evidence supports reporting that the search found no verified declaration, not establishing that AGI has not arrived or lacks broad acceptance through October. The April source describes the AGI clause as dead, so its quotation of the October 2025 panel arrangement does not establish that the process still exists. The unresolved outcome matches the reviews.
